A '''lightsaber''' was created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for practice purposes prior to his ascension to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], with a single, switch-activated [[Color/Legends|purple]] blade and [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] imbued by Windu himself.<ref name="CD" />

Master Windu loaned the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] on an assignment to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] subsequently passed through many hands before coming into the possession of the [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bleth Fahr]]<ref name="CD" /> by [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to {{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf_characterguide&c=swlfc|text=Living Force Character Guidelines}}, the events of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]], of which ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' is part, take place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after those of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], one year before [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> at which [[Time/Legends|time]] Windu held no expectations that the saber would be recovered.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mace Windu's practice lightsaber was introduced by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] in [[2002]]'s ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[RPGA]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' scenario of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]], in which it is provided to Jedi player characters who successfully complete the scenario during its premiere at the [[Celebration II]] event.<ref name="CD" />
